notes: Image 5 must now pass the Doubao gate before it is produced; the other eight images are unchanged.

Doubao scores the rendered size image against cross-border e-commerce criteria and, below 90, returns concrete layout parameters (layout, product scale, product position, text size, spacing) plus the exact problems.
The app applies those parameters, re-renders and re-submits, up to 4 rounds, and only keeps the version Doubao scored 90+.
